script: Can Shaq still dunk at 54 years old? You see, a couple years ago, he was challenged on live TV to dunk, and even though he was able to do it, Shaq said that was probably his last dunk ever. But years later, he wanted to prove himself wrong, especially after this video of him getting blocked by the rim went viral. So after doing some stretches, learning from his last attempt, he pulls out a two handed dunk to surprise the fans.
what_makes_it_work: Strong hook questioning an athletic feat against age
Visual contrast between failing viral clip and successful redemption dunk
Tight narrative arc showing the preparation and payoff
